# Workshop instructions

- Keep the sample planner static, dependency-free and usable without accounts or API keys. Session data is fictional.
- Edit app code in `docs/planner/`, tests in `test/` and attendee material in `docs/`. Do not edit generated `dist/`.
- Verify with `npm ci`, `npm test` and `npm run build`. Check labels, keyboard interaction and responsive layout for UI changes.
- Keep each lab issue in its own worktree. Do not push upstream, modify unrelated files, enable paid services or merge.
